leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement a computed property to memoize derived data in a Vue component
Apply the memoization strategy to optimize expensive calculations in a reactive context
Construct a memoized function using Vue's `computed` API to cache results based on dependencies
Configure a watcher to trigger memoized recomputation only when specific reactive data changes
Update component state and observe how memoized values prevent unnecessary recalculations
Bind memoized computed properties to template expressions for efficient rendering
Integrate memoization with component methods to separate calculation logic from reactive effects
